follow_ups.title: Ordering API: any signed-in shopper can ship any order (PUT /api/orders/ship)
follow_ups.reason: ShipOrderAsync has no role or ownership check, the same kind of authorization gap as this bug.

follow_ups.title: Ordering API: GET /api/orders/{id} returns other shoppers' orders
follow_ups.reason: GetOrderAsync does not check that the order belongs to the caller, so order details leak between shoppers.
